entries.description: Significantly decreases the casting time of Frost Smokescreen's Specialization [Designated Ground Targeting]. Applies Bind: Icebound at 5 stacks. Frost Smokescreen's Burning Smokescreen specialization not applied

entries.description: At 25 stacks of Gale, creates an Acidic Poison area within a 3m radius for 2s that deals 120% of Base Damage to all enemies in the area every 0.5s and applies Weaken: Acidic Poison Weaken: Acidic Poison reduces all Defense by 100 and Movement Speed by 20% for 1s and stacks up to 10 times.

entries.description: When attacking with a Greatsword, increases Base Damage by 0.4% per 1,000 of current Health. Increases by up to 14.4% of Base Damage.

entries.description: Damage Reduction +280 when using Shield Survival Technique

entries.description: When using Shadow Strike, if your Critical Hit Chance is less than 3,000, increases Critical Hit Chance by 700 for 3s. If your Critical Hit Chance is 3,000 or higher, increases Critical Damage by 35% for 3s.

entries.description: When using Summon Constellation, the Milky Way skill can be used 1 time within 6s

entries.name: Ancient Demonic Beast's Footsteps
entries.description: When affected by Collision: Prone from Ascending Cleave, Ascending Slash, Ankle Strike, Desperate Clash, or Tempest Strike, Shield Survival Technique can be used. Immediately removes Bind, Collision, Fear, Silence, Sleep and Stun, dealing 100% of Base Damage to enemies within 3m, and has a 80% chance to apply Collision: Push. Cooldown: 2 min

entries.name: Ancient Demonic Beast's Strike
entries.description: Each attack with Vampiric Strike has a(n) 70% chance to deal fixed damage equal to 400% of Base Damage.

entries.name: Angel Above the Frontier's Mind's Eye
entries.description: Range +9% for the user and their party members within 16m

entries.name: Aridus's Fury
entries.description: Increases Base Damage by 12% if the user is stationary for 3s. Lasts for 2s after moving.

entries.name: Assault Stance
entries.description: On Collision: Push hit with Strategic Rush, increases Collision Chance by 60 for 4s. Max 5 stacks.

entries.name: Atirat's Claw
entries.description: Changes the range of Mad Sword Dance to 10m. Deactivates all targets to self upon skill activation. Boosts Off-hand Weapon Attack Chance by 70% and makes all attacks back attacks for 2s. Ignores Shield Health when dealing damage to PvP targets with Mad Sword Dance. With all damage dealt to PvP targets with Health at 50% or lower, ignores Defense by 2.5% of the target's Max Health. Boosts damage against monsters by up to 50% proportional to Frenzied Sword Dance's growth tier.

entries.name: Atirat's Flame
entries.description: Changes Wild Barrage to an instant cast skill and changes the Attack Range to a 60-degree cone. On hit, has a(n) 80% chance to apply a Weaken effect to the target for 9s that deals Defense-ignoring damage equal to 30% of Base Damage + 6 damage per sec and decreases all CC Resistances by 20. Stacks up to 25 times.

entries.name: Attack Defense Swap
entries.description: When using Eclipse of Blood, increases Critical Damage and Heavy Attack Damage by 16% for 10s. When using Composure, increases Critical Damage Resistance and Heavy Attack Damage Resistance by 16% for 10s.

entries.name: Barrier Crusher
entries.description: When dealing damage with A Shot at Victory, Annihilation Blade, or Earth Strike, has a(n) 80% chance to decrease Shield Health Received by 80% for 9s. If the target is already Shielded, applies Fixed Damage equal to 900% of Base Damage.

entries.name: Battle
entries.description: On each Critical Hit or Heavy Attack hit, increases Block Chance by 1.6% for 3s. Stacks up to 10 times.

entries.name: Battlefield Frenzy
entries.description: Changes Death Knell to Battlefield Frenzy. Increases Skill Damage Boost by 30 and Attack Speed by 3% for 6s on hit with Spear Active Skills. Stacks up to 3 times. At 3 stacks, applies a 15 cooldown.

entries.name: Battlefield Momentum
entries.description: Precision Dash can be charged up to 3 times. When the dash ends, creates a 7m radius area that increases allies' Defense by 5% and decreases enemies' Defense by 5% for 3s. Reusing it within 3s removes the effect for the target.

entries.name: Beast King's Dream Demon
entries.description: Blocking a melee attack decreases the attacker's Move and Attack Speed by 30% for 3s and applies Sleep: Curse for the next 3s (6s for monsters). Cooldown 30s.

entries.description: Magic, Melee, and Ranged Critical Hit Chance +20 per 1m of distance between the user and the target

entries.name: Blade Storm
entries.description: Changes Rapid Shot to [Blade Storm]. Attacks the target 5 times to deal damage proportional to Base Damage and applies a Weaken effect that decreases Magic, Melee, and Ranged Magic Defense by 250 for 6s. Does not apply Multi-Shot's Specialization Shield Removal effect

entries.name: Blazing Tornado
entries.description: Devastating Tornado's Attack Speed +100%, Movement Speed +20% for skill's duration. Attacks apply Serial Fire Bombs' Burning effect.

entries.name: Blessed Haze
entries.description: Changes Karmic Haze to Blessed Haze. Instead of spreading curses to enemies, spreads your Enchanting Time and Valorous Barrier to allies at 33% of their remaining duration.

entries.name: Blessing Steal
entries.description: On hit with Wind Snatcher, has a(n) 90% chance to remove 1 buff from target. Applicable skill effects Invincible Wall, Stalwart Bastion, Fortifying Shell, Trance, Counter Barrier, Unyielding Sentinel, Blessed Barrier, Restoring Constellation, Nature's Blessing, DaVinci's Courage, Starving Shadow, High Focus, Selfless Diffusion, Pain Harvest, Brilliant Moonlight, Umbral Spirit, Distortion Veil, Healing Touch, Inner Peace

entries.name: Blood Valley Fury
entries.description: Melee Heavy Attack +95 for 6s upon applying Stun or Shock with Stunning Blow

entries.name: Blue Flash
entries.description: Changes Javelin Inferno and Explosive Fury to [Lightning Javelin] and [Explosive Lightning Slash]. [Lightning Javelin] Throws a spear at the designated target to deal damage proportional to Base Damage, then chains up to 3 times to 4 random targets within a 4m radius. Lightning Javelin can only be used while the Lightning effect is active. [Explosive Lightning Slash] Deals damage proportional to Base Damage to enemies within an area 1.6x Attack Range. Can be used up to 3 times in succession, and obtains the Lightning effect when dealing damage to enemies. Does not apply Vicious Fury's Additional Condition specialization

entries.name: Burning Purgatory's Vigor
entries.description: On using DaVinci's Courage, Health Regen effect disappears. Base Damage increases by 16, and Duration increases by 1.5s.

entries.name: Chaos Grasp
entries.description: Has a(n) 7.5% chance to apply Touch of Chaos Mastery to all enemy targets.

entries.name: Chernobog's Sleep Venom
entries.description: Upon using Annihilating Slash, has a(n) 80% chance to apply Slow to up to 6 enemies within 5m for 3s, then puts them to Sleep for 6s. Against players, duration is halved. Cooldown: 30s

entries.name: Clay's Purification
entries.description: Changes Clay's Salvation specialization's Weaken removal effect to debuff removal.

entries.name: Cold Snap Erosion
entries.description: When using Frost Cleaving, the area persists for 4s. Applies 2 stacks of Frost to targets in the area, identical to DaVinci's Chill and Ice Tornado. When applying Frost with DaVinci's Chill or Ice Tornado skills within the area, applies 1 additional stack. Boosts Ice Tornado skill damage to Icebound targets by 50%

entries.name: Contagion
entries.description: When the Fatal Stigma effect ends, applies Fatal Stigma to up to 4 targets within a 4m radius after 0.4s. The transferred Fatal Stigma deals damage that is reduced by 50% after 0.4s.

entries.name: Cornelius's Shock
entries.description: On hit with Provoking Roar or Cleaving Roar with [Bonus Damage] Specialization, creates a 4m radius area that explodes after 3s, dealing 400% of Base Damage to targets within the area. Reduces Bonus Damage of targets hit by the explosion by 250% for 5s.

entries.name: Corrupt Hero's Lantern
entries.description: Damage dealt by Vicious Fury, Brutal Fury, and Explosive Fury increases by 8%. On Critical Hit, cooldown of Cyclonic Fury and Phoenix Barrage decrease by 5% proportional to time remaining.

entries.name: Creeping Death
entries.description: When Venomous Edge activates, has a(n) 12% chance to create a 1.5m radius Poison Cloud that follows the attacked target. The Poison Cloud lasts for 3s and deals 140% of Base Damage + 100 damage every sec to targets within range. Boosts damage by 3% per Poison stack. Boosts Poison Cloud Damage by 15%. Does not apply additional effects from Poison Cloud Damage.

entries.name: Crimson Echo
entries.description: Boosts Blood Explosion Damage by 10%, and the target's Bleed Damage over time can no longer be removed.

entries.name: Crimson Imprint
entries.description: Decreases Blood Explosion Damage by 40%, and changes to fixed damage that continues for 3s on hit. Stacks up to 3 times. Damage over time from this effect does not trigger Heavy Attack.

entries.name: Crimson Pursuit
entries.description: If a target attacked with Blood Explosion dies within 3s, decreases the skill's cooldown by 12s. Decreases Blood Explosion PvP Damage by 90%. Increases Blood Explosion Damage against monsters by 35%.

entries.name: Criticality Explosion
entries.description: When using Phoenix Barrage, increases Skill Damage by 8% per stack of Weaken: Burst applied to the target. When each hit of Phoenix Barrage lands as a Critical Hit, applies 3 stacks of Weaken: Ignite. When Phoenix Barrage hits a target with 10 stacks of Weaken: Ignite, deals explosion damage equal to 690% of Base Damage + 399 damage.

entries.name: Daigon's Fury
entries.description: Staff Fire Skill's damage increases 5%, Burning damage increases 15%

entries.name: Daigon's Storm
entries.description: Boosts Whirling Shield Damage by 25%, and increases Whirling Shield's ricochet effect to 7 times. The shield can hit the same target multiple times. Upon landing a Shield Strike after using Whirling Shield for 6s, has a(n) 80% chance to fire a Whirling Shield projectile that deals 135% of Base Damage.

entries.name: Dark Order's Shock Wave
entries.description: On Shield Strike, Stun the target for 0.3s

entries.name: Dark Wing's Bulwark
entries.description: Max Health increases 2,000 Magic Defense increases 300

entries.name: Dark Wing's Power
entries.description: Melee and Ranged Defense 300 Max Mana 1000

entries.name: Dead Man's Armor
entries.description: Changes Icebound Armor skill to Dead Man's Armor. Deals 80% of Base Damage as Icebound damage per sec and applies Frost to nearby foes, and has a(n) 80% chance to apply Terror: Pull.

entries.name: Deadly Grave
entries.description: Creates an area in a 3m radius around Brutal Arrow's target location that deals 40% of Base Damage every 0.5s for 5s

entries.name: Deception
entries.description: Increases Threat Boost and Taunt duration by 3s.

entries.name: Deckman's Rampage
entries.description: Ray of Disaster damage increases by 25%. Inflicts the Corrupted Magic Circle effect on the targets. Target number increases to 4 with target expansion.

entries.name: Deluzhnoa's Barrier
entries.description: Phantom Smokescreen's cooldown is decreased by 30%, and has a(n) 80% chance to apply Petrification: Icebound to all enemies within range for 1.5s every sec. Disabled upon getting hit once.

entries.name: Deluzhnoa's Cold
entries.description: Arrow Vortex cooldown -30%. Deals 100% of Base Damage to the first enemy hit by Arrow Vortex. Also deals 120% of Base Damage to all enemies within 3m of the initial target. Has a(n) 80% chance to apply Collision: Push and send target airborne for 3s. Damage boost +50% against monsters. Transfers the effect to another target within a 5m radius area once. Deals damage up to 6 times.

entries.name: Deluzhnoa's Hail
entries.description: Hellfire Rain changes into Ice Rain. The Casting Speed increases by 50%, the range changes to 5m, and Rain quantity increases to 18. Removes Burning effects. Increases damage by 15%, and has a(n) 80% chance to Weaken targets, reducing their Movement Speed by 51% for 2.5s. Staff Ice Skill Damage Boost +10%.

entries.name: Deluzhnoa's Torrent
entries.description: On Chain Strike: Uppercut hit, summons a vortex in a 3m radius area that deals 80% of Base Damage per sec for 3s. On Bloodstorm: Blood Talon use, deals 160% of Base Damage in a 5m radius area per sec for 3s. Damaged targets have a 80% chance to be affected by Collision: Airborne for 1.5s. Boosts damage against monsters by 160%.

entries.name: Deluzhnoa's Touch
entries.description: Increases Controlling Rake's hit area to 4m and reduces Movement Speed of all enemies in the area by 60%. On a successful hit, Damage Reduction +6 for 5s. Stacks up to 10 times.

entries.name: Deluzhnoa's Waves
entries.description: Changes Rising Slash's range to 8m and boosts damage by 60%. Rising Slash can be used in the target direction. Activates an additional Active skill 1s after use, and has an 80% chance to apply Collision: Push to targets while charging. Targets that collide with a wall are stunned for 3s.

entries.name: Destruction Empress's Gale
entries.description: Base Damage +25 for 3s upon using Daggers Mobility Skills

entries.name: Destructive Monarch's Barrier
entries.description: Adds an effect to Invincible Wall that reduces Damage Taken by -5% and increases Healing Received by 10%

entries.name: Devastating Chain
entries.description: Chain Hook additionally attacks 1 enemy in a 5m radius around the target.

entries.name: Devotion Barrier
entries.description: When using Blood Devotion or Devoted Sanctuary, creates a shield on you and a target equal to 15% of your Max Health that ignores shield removal effects for 6s, and removes Shield Health ▼ and Shield Health Received ▼ effects.

entries.name: Disruption Shot
entries.description: On Recoil Shot hit, has a(n) 100% chance to apply a Weaken effect for 6s that decreases Magic, Melee, and Ranged Hit Chance by 60 and Magic, Melee, and Ranged Evasion by 60. On Wave Shot hit, applies 3 stacks

entries.name: Divine Retribution
entries.description: On dealing damage to a target with 5 stacks of Burst using Ascending Cleave, decreases Ascending Cleave's cooldown by 2.5s. Boosts Ascending Cleave's damage against monsters by 30%.

entries.name: Double Trap
entries.description: Explosive Trap can now be charged up to 2 times, the number that can be set up simultaneously increases by 1, and explosion time decreases by 1s.

entries.name: Dragon's Counterattack
entries.description: On Valiant Brawl or Slash Wave hit, has a(n) 80% chance to apply Provoke to the target for 4s and grants the attacker an effect that has a(n) 70% chance to deal counter damage equal to 75% of Base Damage when hit by a taunted target within 15m. Boosts Valiant Brawl, Cruel Smite, and Slash Wave damage by 35% and increases their cooldown by 3s.

entries.name: Dragon's Intimidation
entries.description: Changes Fountain of Life to [Dragon's Intimidation]. Applies Fountain of Life to 1 party member at the designated location and follows the target. When used, has a(n) 60% chance to apply Fear to enemies within range or enemies entering within range for 3s, ignoring Evasion and Resistance. Targets affected by Fear become immune to that Fear for 20s.

entries.name: Earth Strike
entries.description: Changes A Shot at Victory to [Earth Strike]. Deals damage proportional to Base Damage to all targets within a 3m radius, and grants an effect that increases damage of sword skills for a set duration after using the skill. Does not apply A Shot at Victory's Annihilation Blade specialization

entries.name: Elemental Fusion
entries.description: Activates Special Skills in addition to the existing effects when the Elemental Awakening Skill is changed to [Elemental Fusion] and 7 Elemental stacks are reached. Frost Smokescreen and Burning Smokescreen Skills change to [Lava Dust] (Fury Attack). Deals 300% of Base Damage per sec to foes within range and applies Weaken: Lava Dust for 6s. When Weaken: Lava Dust reaches 4 stacks, applies Petrify for 4s. [Designated Ground Targeting] Specialization can be applied. - Ice Spear Bombardment and Detonator Bombardment Skills change to [Magnetic Field]. Deals Lightning Damage equal to 1100% of Base Damage to hit enemies and applies Weaken: Magnetic Field, which decreases Movement Speed by 60% for 2.5s. Magnetic Field transfers to foes within 5m up to 2 times, with 1 additional transfer if the target is Wet or affected by your own Frost Effect. Decreases damage by 20% with each transfer. - Inferno Wave and Frenzied Lightning Wave Skills change to [Firestorm]. Firestorm follows the target for 6s and deals damage equal to 360% of Base Damage and applies Weaken: Burning.

If Collision: Push is applied, has a(n) 80% chance to apply a Weaken effect that decreases Heavy Attack Damage Resistance by 20% for 6s. Targets that collide with a wall are stunned for 3s.

entries.name: Enraged Giant Cordy's Blessing
entries.description: Becomes immune to Bind, Fear, Petrification, Silence, Sleep, and Stun for 2s when casting Invincible Wall, and boosts the effect by 85%.

entries.name: Enraged Giant Cordy's Bog
entries.description: At 25 Gale stacks, an explosion deals 400% of Base Damage to all enemies within 3.5m, and has a(n) 80% chance to apply Collision: Pull, pulling the target into the center.

entries.name: Enraged Giant Cordy's Forest Resonance
entries.description: Boosts Guardian Defensive Wall Health by 50%. Using a Guardian Defensive Wall has a(n) 80% chance to apply Collision: Push to enemies within range and push them outside the range. If strengthened with 2 or more Orbs, applies Collision Immunity to party members within range.

entries.name: Enraged Giant Cordy's Spore Poison
entries.description: On hit with the Death Blow skill, creates a 3m-wide Poison Cloud that ignores Block Chance around the target for 4s. Enemies within the cloud take damage over time equal to 132% of Base Damage every 0.5s, and Magic, Melee, and Ranged Evasion are reduced by 300. Increases damage by 100% against monsters. In PvP, deals Defense-ignoring damage equal to 2% of the target's max Health per sec.

entries.name: Enraged Leviathan's Incineration
entries.description: When using Evaporation, additionally decreases damage taken by 20% and additionally decreases Movement Speed by 25%. Applies damage over time that deals fixed damage equal to 50% of Base Damage + 120 damage to targets within the area every 0.5s for 1s. Stacks up to 3 times.

entries.name: Enraged Leviathan's Specter
entries.description: Umbral Spirit and Thunder Spirit damage increases 30%, Duration on Melee Critical Hit increases 0.2s (up to 20s max)

entries.name: Enraged Leviathan's Sting
entries.description: Zephyr's Nock shoots an additional projectile at up to 2 targets within 5m, dealing damage equal to 450% of Base Damage. Zephyr's Nock damage also increases by 12%.

entries.name: Enraged Pakilo Naru's Barrier
entries.description: On damaging a target with a Spear skill, increases all CC Resistances by 32 for 4s (once per skill). Stacks up to 10 times.

entries.name: Enraged Pakilo Naru's Cruelty
entries.description: Boosts Valiant Brawl, Cruel Smite, and Slash Wave Damage by 25% and Boosts their Cooldown Reduction effect by 50%.

entries.name: Enraged Primal Brothers' Thunder Strike
entries.description: Upon summoning an Orb, generates a 3m radius area of thunder after 2s at a random enemy location within a 6m radius of the summoned Orb that deals 420% of Base Damage.

entries.name: Enraged Queen Bellandir's Corruptive Venom
entries.description: On Critical Hit with crossbows, has 20% chance to apply Weaken: Poison, which deals 170% of Base Damage over time every sec for 5s. Stacks up to 3 times. Damage Reduction decreases by 28 for the Poisoned targets.

entries.name: Enraged Queen Bellandir's Explosive Insect
entries.description: On applying Weaken: Burning with Staff Skills, has a 7% chance to apply the Explosive Insect effect. Explosive Insects explode after 3s, dealing 540% of Base Damage to the target and 1080% of Base Damage to all other enemies in a 4m radius.

entries.name: Enraged Queen Bellandir's Gravity Field
entries.description: On Explosive Flurry or Blood Spiral hit, applies Collision: Pull to all targets within a 5m radius. This effect ignores the target's Evasion.

entries.name: Enraged Queen Bellandir's Hunger
entries.description: Reduces cooldown of Death From Above by 15s and applies Collision: Pull on Feared enemies through the Death From Above skill. Death From Above Damage +600%

entries.name: Enraged Queen Bellandir's Quicksand
entries.description: Creates 5m radius of Quicksand on the spot where Annihilating Slash was used. Quicksand decreases enemy Movement Speed by 60% and has a 90% chance to apply Collision: Pull to enemies within the radius when it disappears after 2s. Cooldown 18s

entries.name: Enraged Tevent's Bombardment
entries.description: Shoots a bonus projectile whenever using Strafing, dealing 82% of Base Damage

entries.name: Enraged Tevent's Corruption
entries.description: Applies a Consuming Aura for 10s to the enemy first hit by Star Destroyer or to the nearest enemy within 6m when a Supernova Collapse area is generated. Enemies within 3m of the Aura's range has a(n) 80% chance to receive damage equal to 90% of Base Damage every 0.5s. Damage increases by 300% against monsters. Applies a Weaken effect that increases Debuff Duration per stack by 12%. (Stacks up to 5 times)

entries.name: Enraged Tevent's Despair Trap
entries.description: Upon applying Collision, Shock, or Stun with Greatsword Skills, creates an area in a 1.5m radius around the target that explodes in 1.5s, dealing 325% of Base Damage within the area. It explodes one more time after 1.5s outside the area, and deals 325% damage to the additional 1.5m area. Damage increases by 50% against monsters.

entries.name: Enraged Tevent's Furious Rage
entries.description: Increases Hit Chance by 250 for 5s after expiration of Camouflage Cloak, and resets cooldown on target kills or kill assists within that duration. Cooldown: 10s Camouflage Cloak deals 410% of Base Damage to all enemies in a 4m radius, with a 70% chance to apply Collision: Push.

entries.name: Enraged Tevent's Hunger
entries.description: On applying Curse of the Wand, has a 15% chance to apply Weaken: Curse, which deals 35% of Base Damage per sec and decreases Defense by 10% for 30s. Damage increases by 100% against monsters.

entries.name: Excavator's Barrier
entries.description: When using Swift Healing on a target below 30% Health, applies a Shield equal to 450% of Base Damage +1500. Cooldown: 30s

entries.name: Execution
entries.description: When Fatal Stigma deals PvP damage, if the target's Health is 10% or lower, instantly kills the damaged target.

entries.name: Explosive Arrow
entries.description: Changes Recoil Shot and Wave Shot to [Explosive Arrow]. When using Recoil Shot, deals damage proportional to Base Damage to all foes within a 3m radius, and has a(n) 80% chance to apply Burning identical to Serial Fire Bombs to the target. When using Wave Shot, deals damage to all foes within a 4m radius of the target and has a(n) 80% chance to apply Burning identical to Serial Fire Bombs. When Gale specialization is active, applies 2 additional stacks of Burning.

entries.name: Eye of Ventius
entries.description: Creates an aftershock 1s after the Decisive Sniping arrow passes, and applies damage 3 to 6 times on all targets within a 3m radius. Boosts damage dealt with Eye of Ventius against monsters by 20%. Decreases PvP Damage dealt with Eye of Ventius by 90%.

entries.name: False Time
entries.description: Activating an Orb Effect increases duration of Orbs within a 30m radius by 0.5s.

entries.name: Fear Erosion
entries.description: When Afterimage's additional effect trait is applied, increases Terror duration by 1s. Additionally, decreases Movement Speed by 40% and decreases all Defense by 500

entries.name: Flash
entries.description: On each hit with Devastating Tornado, Blazing Tornado, or Icebound Tornado, boosts damage by 12% for 3s, stacking up to 99 times. Hitting with a skill from behind applies 3 stacks. When hitting monsters with Devastating Tornado, Blazing Tornado, or Icebound Tornado, decreases Devastating Smash cooldown by 0.2s. entries.description: Increases Off-hand Weapon Damage by 90.

entries.name: Spineflower Warden's Seduction
entries.description: On skill hit, creates a(n) 80% chance of reducing all Endurance of the target by 12 for 3s. Increase user's Base Damage by 3. Stacks up to 10 times.

entries.name: Spiral Assault
entries.description: Boosts Culling Arc and Flaming Arc damage by 20% and grants 4 extra Spiral Slash uses.

entries.name: Star of Rest
entries.description: While within 4m during Healing Star or Purifying Star's duration, applies a buff that increases party members' damage against all species by 100

entries.name: Star's Orbit
entries.description: Boosts Milky Way damage by 10%, and grants 1 additional use

entries.name: Stealthy Arrowhead
entries.description: Enchants additional projectiles from Roxie's Arrowhead and Roxie's Arrow Storm, increasing the Activation Rate by 12% and damage by 50% of Base Damage. Does not apply additional effects from additional projectiles.

entries.name: Stellar Star Destroyer
entries.description: Boosts Stellar Star Destroyer damage by 30%, and changes Star Destroyer to [Stellar Star Destroyer]. Summons 9 Stellar Star Destroyers on the target, each dealing 275% of Base Damage + 225 damage.

entries.name: Strength Barrier
entries.description: Increases Critical Damage Resistance by 40% while Counter Barrier is active

entries.name: Support Fire
entries.description: Changes Explosive Trap to [Support Fire] Installing an Arbalest at the designated location and using Quick Fire, Recoil Shot, Wave Shot, or Explosive Arrow triggers the Arbalest to use the same skill against the target. Explosive Trap's Duration ▲ specialization not applied

entries.name: Swift Judgment
entries.description: Removes the cast time of Judgment Lightning, instantly casting it 2 times upon the application of the [Consecutive Use] specialization. When the second Judgment Lightning hits a monster as a Heavy Attack, decreases the skill's cooldown by 50%

entries.name: Talus's Glacier
entries.description: When Stunned, trigger Petrification: Freeze for 1s to protect the user. Cooldown: 24s

entries.name: Talus's Transcendent Barrier
entries.description: Upon using Distortion Veil, applies a Distortion Veil to the nearest ally without Distortion Veil within a 5m radius from the target.

entries.name: Target Lock
entries.description: Adds Strafing's Bullseye and Gale effects once

entries.name: Tectonic Shift
entries.description: Changes Interstellar Explosion to [Tectonic Shift] and consumes only 1 orb at the designated location to trigger a tectonic shift after 1s. Deals 530% of Base Damage + 216 damage to up to 5 targets within a 5m radius and has a(n) 80% chance to apply Collision: Pull.

entries.name: Tevent's Bombardment
entries.description: Shoots a bonus projectile whenever using Strafing, dealing 54% of Base Damage

entries.name: Tevent's Corruption
entries.description: Applies a Consuming Aura for 10s to the enemy first hit by Star Destroyer or to the nearest enemy within 6m when a Supernova Collapse area is generated. Enemies within 3m of the Aura's range has a(n) 80% chance to receive damage equal to 60% of Base Damage every 0.5s. Damage increases by 300% against monsters. Applies a Weaken effect that increases Debuff Duration per stack by 8%. (Stacks up to 5 times)

entries.name: Tevent's Despair Trap
entries.description: Upon applying Collision, Shock, or Stun with Greatsword Skills, creates an area in a 1.5m radius around the target that explodes in 1.5s, dealing 325% of Base Damage. Damage increases by 50% against monsters.

entries.name: Tevent's Furious Rage
entries.description: Resets Camouflage Cloak cooldown on target kills or kill assists within 5s of its expiration. Cooldown: 10s Camouflage Cloak deals 205% of Base Damage to all enemies in a 3m radius, with a 70% chance to apply Collision: Push.

entries.name: Tevent's Hunger
entries.description: On applying Curse of the Wand, has a 15% chance to apply Weaken: Curse, dealing 35% of Base Damage per sec for 30s. Damage increases by 100% against monsters.

entries.name: Thuban's Verdict
entries.description: On hit with Fatal Stigma, boosts Off-Hand Weapon Activation Chance by 25% for the duration of the mark, and accumulates damage dealt to the marked target up to 50000%. When the mark ends, it explodes to deal additional damage equal to 15% of the accumulated damage.

entries.name: Thunder Bombardment
entries.description: When using Thundering Bomb, if the target is Wet or affected by your Frost status, deals additional damage proportional to the target's Weaken: Thunderclouds stacks and the same damage to other enemies within a 3m radius.

entries.name: Thunder Call
entries.description: Boosts Cleaving Moonlight Damage by 10%. On Cleaving Moonlight skill hit, if the target has Weaken: Thunderclouds, removes 3 stacks of the effect and calls down lightning to attack the target and deal 400% damage. Upon hitting monsters, removes 5 stacks of Weaken: Thunderclouds and deals 700% damage.

entries.name: Thunder of Hatred and Disillusionment
entries.description: Staff Lightning Skill Damage increases by 5%, Lightning skill's Mana Cost decreases by 10%

entries.name: Thunder's Shadow
entries.description: Changes Inner Peace Specialization 1 [Thunder's Blessing] to [Thunder's Shadow] which applies to enemy targets. Increases damage by WP_Item_Gear_ST_01_1_DD.tooltip1-WP_ST_S_ManaRengeUp_trait1_DD.tooltip1% and applies Weaken: Thunderclouds. If any two of Thunder's Shadow, Lightning Condensation, and Thunderclouds Explosion are applied simultaneously, only the highest damage boost effect is applied.

entries.name: Thunderclouds Explosion
entries.description: The falling lightning strikes of Thunder's Blessing and Thunder's Shadow deal WP_Item_Gear_ST_01_3_DD_BOSS.tooltip1-WP_ST_S_ManaRengeUp_trait1_DD.tooltip1% increased AoE Damage to up to 3 targets within a 1m radius. If any two of Thunder's Shadow, Lightning Condensation, and Thunderclouds Explosion are applied simultaneously, only the highest damage boost effect is applied. Boosts Thunderclouds Explosion's Damage against monsters by 150% Decreases Thunderclouds Explosion's PvP Damage by 90%

entries.name: Torrent
entries.description: While in a Whirlpool area, Zephyr's Nock and Strafing transform into a multi-shot skill that deals damage to up to 6 targets within a 3m radius upon landing a hit. Boosts damage dealt with waves against monsters by 50%. Decreases PvP Damage dealt with waves by 90%.

entries.name: Triple Snipe
entries.description: Changes Decisive Sniping to a movement skill called [Triple Snipe] that can be used 3 times. Reuse before firing an arrow to leap immediately and become immune to Bind, Collision, Fear, Sleep and Stun while leaping. The third leap has a farther distance. Decisive Sniping's Charging Time ▲, Charging Time ▼, and Directional Tempest specializations not applied

entries.name: Variation
entries.description: Increases the effect of Unpredictable by 50%.

entries.name: Venomous Swamp
entries.description: Melee critical hits now activate Venomous Edge, and has a(n) 5% chance to create a 3m radius Poison Cloud that lingers at the activation location for 3s. If Creeping Death is equipped, changes activation chance to 12%. Boosts damage by 3% per Poison stack. Boosts damage dealt with Venomous Edge and Poison Cloud against monsters by 15%. Decreases PvP Damage dealt with Venomous Edge and Poison Cloud by 90%. Does not apply additional effects with Poison Cloud Damage.

entries.name: Victory Strike
entries.description: Increases Earth Strike range by 3m. Boosts A Shot at Victory, Annihilation Blade, and Earth Strike Damage by 5%.

entries.name: Void Echo
entries.description: When Void Slash's Orb effect activates, re-activates Void Slash from all activated orbs to deal 420% of Base Damage.

entries.name: Wall of Bitter Cold
entries.description: Changes Stalwart Bastion to [Wall of Bitter Cold], and decreases cooldown by 30%. While the effect lasts, deals damage equal to 150% of Base Damage when attacked from within 15m and has a(n) 30% chance to apply Weaken: Frost that decreases Movement Speed by 35% for 3s. Affected targets cannot receive Stalwart Bastion from another caster for 45s.

entries.name: Wave
entries.description: Slash Wave strikes once and can be used up to 3 times in a row. Deals damage proportional to Base Damage to all targets in its path. Decreases Movement Speed by 50% while casting. Decreases PvP Damage of Valiant Brawl, Cruel Smite, and Slash Wave by 90%. Boosts damage of Valiant Brawl, Cruel Smite, and Slash Wave against monsters by 30%.

entries.name: Wave of Punishment
entries.description: Changes the effect of Ascending Cleave. Ascending Cleave's Collision: Prone, Push, and Stun effects only apply to monsters. On applying Shock or dealing damage to a Shocked target with Ascending Cleave, creates 6 shock waves that deal 750% of Base Damage to enemies within a 2.5m radius. If the shock waves deal damage, decreases Ascending Cleave's remaining cooldown by 8%, up to 6 times. Decreases Ascending Cleave's PvP damage by 90%.

entries.name: Wave Resonance
entries.description: Decreases remaining cooldown of Earthquake and Blood Spiral by 2.5% proportional to the number of targets hit by Sweep. For each target hit by Earthquake or Blood Spiral, decreases remaining cooldown of Sweep by 2.5%. Increases PvP Damage Taken by 100% .Decreases PvP Damage Dealt by 90%.

entries.name: Whirlpool Awakening
entries.description: Increases Whirlpool range by 2m, and increases duration by 3s.

entries.name: Wild Barrage
entries.description: Merciless Barrage now attacks all enemies in a 30-degree cone. Damage increases by 15%. Movement Speed decreases by 20% while using the skill.

entries.name: Will Eruption
entries.description: Changes Willbreaker into a support skill that increases Species Damage Boost by 120 and PvP Damage Dealt by 5% for all party members within 15m for 6s.

entries.name: Will of Fonsiné
entries.description: When Quick Fire is cast, decreases the cooldown of Multi-Shot, Rapid Shot, Collision Shot, Blade Storm, and Frost Expansion by 1.5s. [Blade Storm] Increases the number of attacks by 2 and applies Gale for 6s. [Frost Expansion] Upon hitting a target, has a(n) 80% chance to change to Bind: Icebound for 1.5s and increases Bind duration by 1.5s when Icebound is applied to an already Icebound target. Decreases PvP Damage by 90%. Boosts the damage of Multi-Shot, Rapid Shot, Collision Shot, Blade Storm, and Frost Expansion against monsters by 50%.

entries.name: Wind Blades
entries.description: When Spiral Slash lands as a heavy attack, Spiral Slash is used 1 additional time. (Max 1 time)

entries.name: Wind's Guidance
entries.description: Increases Movement Speed of self and party members within 16m by 8% and increases Magic, Melee, and Ranged Evasion by 160

entries.name: Witch Worshipper's Anathema
entries.description: Ensnaring Arrow changes to a location/directional skill. On hit, deals damage equal to 130% of Base Damage. Explodes in 3s to bind enemies within 3m from the target and deals the same damage. If the target is killed before the explosion, it explodes immediately. Bosses immune to bind become oppressed instead.

entries.name: Witch Worshipper's Corrosive Curse
entries.description: On Bloodleech Aura skill hit, has a(n) 80% chance to Weaken the target, which applies Melee Defense -600 for 3s.

entries.name: Witch Worshipper's Temptation
entries.description: Salvation Chain changes to Witch Worshipper's Temptation. On skill hit, has a(n) 80% chance to apply Fear: Seduction to a target, making the target follow the caster for 4s and increases PvP damage taken by 15%.

entries.name: Wretched Sin's Ambush
entries.description: When the user's Health falls below 20%, becomes Stealthed for 3s. Cooldown 120s.
